title: Integrations
content: # Integrations Put an ElevenLabs or Retell agent on a Zernio number by SIP forwarding or a SIP trunk, while the number, its KYC, SMS and WhatsApp stay with Zernio. import { Cards, Card } from 'fumadocs-ui/components/card'; Put an external voice platform on a Zernio number. The number, its countries and KYC, SMS and WhatsApp stay with Zernio. The platform handles the calls. Each guide covers 2 lanes: - **SIP forwarding**: forward inbound calls to the platform's SIP address. - **SIP trunk**: import the number into the platform so it can also place outbound calls. On either lane you need a [number](/platforms/phone-numbers/setup), an agent on the platform and usage-based billing. } title="Retell" href="/platforms/voice/integrations/retell" description="Retell agents over SIP forwarding, or number import over a SIP trunk" /> Vapi is a `sip:` destination too. A media server of your own takes a `wss://` forward destination. See [AI voice agents](/platforms/voice/ai-agents).
